lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Ten syndicate heads, one room, no shooting. If this works I'm framing it.

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: A table. Neutral ground. That's a choice.

lines.speaker: Captain Resh
lines.text: You've summoned the ten.

lines.speaker: Gryph
lines.text: Ten worst people in the galaxy in one room. This story writes itself.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: I came to kill you, once. Strange, what a table can do instead.

lines.speaker: Coral Vex
lines.text: That makes eleven, if we're counting the man standing at the head.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: You've heard the rumors. The Dominion sent a retrieval order that never came home.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: That's because the order was forged by the Hollow Kings to fracture the Ronin Program from inside. Overseer Khall was manipulated into nearly destroying me. But the Dominion's real architect, First Overseer Maelgorn and the Obsidian Synod, still controls the failsafe network that leashes every operative alive.

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: You hunted us for a decade, Ronin. Now you set a table. Why should ten old enemies share a knife?

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Because the Dominion taught all of us the same lesson. They took me as a child and made me a sword to point at you. They took your people too, harvested, augmented, sold. We've been fighting each other inside a cage the Dominion built. I mean to break it.

lines.speaker: Coral Vex
lines.text: He's not lying. I'd know.

lines.speaker: Dominion Strike Leader
lines.text: All units converge! Target is assembled! Breach pattern seven!

lines.speaker: Dominion Trooper 1
lines.text: Contact! All targets in assembly! Weapons hot!

lines.speaker: Dominion Trooper 2
lines.text: Formation compromised! Retreat, retreat!

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: You're safe. The collar is dead. You're people again.

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: You could have killed those two.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: They're children with chips in their heads. So was I.

lines.speaker: Captain Resh
lines.text: You're telling me there's a way to end the auction.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: The failsafe network that controls every operative runs from one place. The Obsidian Synod. We burn the Synod, the Dominion's nervous system dies, and every weapon they ever made stops being a slave.

lines.speaker: Gryph
lines.text: Ten syndicates storming the throne of the empire. I'm in for the story alone.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: The Pact is struck.

lines.speaker: Coral Vex
lines.text: Three shells. Outer shield-lattice, a void-dock gauntlet, then the Synod sanctum itself.

lines.speaker: Coral Vex
lines.text: And this is the Beacon. The failsafe network's heart. If Maelgorn triggers it during the assault, every chipped operative still alive turns into a weapon aimed at us.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Then someone has to reach the Beacon and kill it before the rest of us reach Maelgorn.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: I can reach it. I built half of it.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: He stays. He gave me back to myself. Let him pay the rest of what he owes.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: I dismantled what I could from the inside. It was not enough. Let me end the part that still wears my fingerprints.

lines.speaker: Morrigan
lines.text: How long to reach the Beacon from the void-dock?

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: If the shields fall, twenty minutes. But the Beacon itself will fight us.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Then we have twenty minutes to kill a god.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: All units, maintain formation. Lattice emitters coming online, gryph, those ramming runs you wanted.

lines.speaker: Gryph
lines.text: That's one! Bring 'em!

lines.speaker: Maelgorn
lines.text: Soren. Yes, I know the name you clawed back. It changes nothing. You are property that learned to talk.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Property doesn't bring nine friends and a fleet.

lines.speaker: Maelgorn
lines.text: When I light the Beacon, every operative you spared will finish what I started.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: He means it. Get me to the core.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Coral, Morrigan, the data-spine. Seize the Synod's records before they can be purged.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Dr. Heris, Resh, the Crucible Decks. The Dominion's next harvest sleeps there.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Mera, Vess, Gryph, Cassie-04, Sable Dross, hold the dock and carve the road to the sanctum. No one gets past you.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Khall and I are going to the Beacon.

lines.speaker: Captain Resh
lines.text: How many children?

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Thousands. Get them out. That's the whole reason we came.

lines.speaker: Dr. Heris
lines.text: I put augments into bodies that small for fifteen years. Let me be the one who takes them back out.

lines.speaker: Obsidian Trooper 1
lines.text: Sector three compromised! Operative-class contact!

lines.speaker: Dominion Guard 1
lines.text: Contact on the medical level! Defensive formation!

lines.speaker: Dr. Heris
lines.text: One hundred seventeen in this chamber. Moving to next.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: Beyond this is the Beacon. And likely her.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Samurai-4.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: She was the finest after you. Maelgorn keeps her closest.

lines.speaker: Maelgorn
lines.text: Watch, Soren. Watch what loyalty costs.

lines.speaker: Samurai-4
lines.text: Run.

lines.speaker: Samurai-4
lines.text: End this. Please end this.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: The Beacon is dark. We're coming.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: It's dark, Seven. The network's dark. No more leashes.

lines.speaker: Samurai-4
lines.text: You came back. You said you would.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Always.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: The children are walking free. Every operative in the Synod is unplugged now. That's the whole reason we came.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: I'm sorry. For all of it.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: You gave me the choice in the end. Spend the last of it knowing the children walk free.

lines.speaker: Maelgorn
lines.text: You unplugged my network and killed my handler. Sentiment. The Dominion is not a machine you switch off, Soren. It is an idea, that some are born to be used. Kill me and ten others take my chair.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: That's why I didn't come with only a sword. I came with the ten chairs you used to terrify the galaxy into obedience. Look who's sitting in them now.

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: Cover left! Moving through!

lines.speaker: Maelgorn
lines.text: You think criminals will rule better than emperors?

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: No. I think no one should rule the way you did. That's the difference.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Whatever you're doing, do it leaving. This whole tomb is coming down.

lines.speaker: Sable Dross
lines.text: Power vacuum. By tomorrow every warlord and every splinter syndicate will be carving up the worlds we just freed. We didn't end the war. We started ten of them.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Then we don't let go. The reach you each built to prey on people, turn it to protect them instead.

lines.speaker: Privateers Commander
lines.text: Convoy is undefended! Moving to intercept!

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: Hold formation! No transport is lost!

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: My own people did that. The ones who wanted the dark to stay dark.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Then they're your work now. Every one of you knows your own kind better than any law could. That's the point.

lines.speaker: Coral Vex
lines.text: A protector who knows where every body is buried. We'd be... unprecedented.

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: I take the trade-lanes. The routes of every synced, the hidden channels where children used to move. They move to freedom now, or they move to me.

lines.speaker: Morrigan
lines.text: I take the truth. That no lie like the one done to Soren is ever planted in an operative's mind again. The Hollow Kings' greatest strength was secrets. Now secrets are a weapon they never see coming.

lines.speaker: Captain Resh
lines.text: I take the children. Every harvest line hunted to its root. Every auction block burned. The Saffron Veil ran black-market operations. Now it runs orphanages.

lines.speaker: Dr. Heris
lines.text: I take the augmented. To unmake the leashes I once built. The Gilded Maw was the Dominion's surgeon. Now it's the galaxy's healer. Every operative who was chained gets the choice of free will or peace.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: I take the dead and the grieving. The monastery's doors open to all who want to learn that even weapons can be unmade. The Pale Choir sang for the powerful. Now we sing for everyone they broke.

lines.speaker: Gryph
lines.text: I take the lawless rim. The pits, the abandoned stations, the places where hope goes to die. The Rustfangs broke people for sport. Now we defend what's defenseless there.

lines.speaker: Sable Dross
lines.text: I take the water and the worlds that thirst. The Tide Barons drowned operatives in the deep. Now the deep protects instead of traps.

lines.speaker: Cassie-04
lines.text: I take the freed operatives, my own kind, scattered and waking. The Ninefold Bank measured every life in debt. Now we measure success in how many walk free.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: I take the guns. Every weapon the Dominion ever made. To point them only outward now. The Emberhand remembers fire and loss. Now we burn only what would burn others.

lines.speaker: Coral Vex
lines.text: I take the watch. The eyes that never close. The Vellum Exchange trades in secrets, now we trade in truth. Every operation, every command, every scrap of intelligence gets put where it can protect, never prey.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: You spent your lives taking. Spend the rest of them keeping.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The ten worst people in the galaxy and the man they built to kill them, swearing to babysit creation. Nobody is going to believe me.

lines.speaker: Samurai-4
lines.text: What now, Seven?

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Now they're safe. And I get to find out who I am when no one's pointing me at anything.

lines.speaker: Samurai-4
lines.text: Then let's go find out.
